tasks.short: Develop and implement radiological protection training

steps.what: Develop radiological protection, detection and decontamination training procedures with technical specialists
Implement training procedures through supervised practice and participant feedback

tasks.design: Keep specialist procedure development and supervised implementation with people, using {DOCS} for reviewed material. Generic course-drafting savings belong to the separate preparedness-training task and are not counted again here.
tasks.previous_blocker: Training must match specialist guidance, equipment and local response arrangements.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing approved instructions and specialist review support procedure development.
tasks.still_hard: Making training technically correct and usable under realistic conditions.
tasks.human_edge: The director and specialists detect misunderstandings during practice.

reach.learn: Recognize where local procedures require specialist validation

evidence.claim: Manual specialist training development and implementation are proposed here; the digest provides no measured radiological training automation case.

assumptions: This is specialist procedure development and implementation, not another allocation of generic course drafting.

The director gathers and checks technical guidance with existing specialists in s1; all focal consultation time remains counted. No new specialist service or structured readiness requirement is introduced.
Practice observations are generated during s2 and used for feedback within that step.
Existing DOCS and instructions suffice; there is no new automated service or incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Which training procedures require specialist review before local adaptation?

already_counted.description: Specialist consultation, procedure development and supervised implementation

incremental.description: No new service beyond existing specialist participation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 gives zero gross and net saving. Generic course-drafting gains are excluded to avoid overlap.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Inventory and distribute detection equipment and instruct users

steps.what: Inventory detection and contamination equipment through physical verification and asset capture
Reconcile equipment inventory observations and prepare discrepancy and issue lists
Resolve inventory discrepancies, distribute equipment and instruct recipients in maintenance and use

tasks.design: Configure asset reconciliation in {OPS_SYSTEM} after the director physically verifies equipment and captures observations. Retain all suitability decisions, physical distribution and maintenance instruction with people using approved {DOCS} material.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated comparison of physical counts and equipment lists.
tasks.enabler_now: Native asset records can match identifiers and expose discrepancies.
tasks.still_hard: Actual condition, suitability and whether recipients understand equipment limitations.
tasks.human_edge: The director inspects equipment, resolves missing evidence and checks recipient understanding.

reach.learn: Distinguish an inventory match from evidence of serviceability

evidence.claim: Native asset reconciliation is a proposed deterministic E1 design; no measured specialist equipment inventory case is supplied.

assumptions: Only repeated inventory comparison is removed; physical inspection, transport and instruction remain fully counted.

In s1 the director produces asset identifier, observed quantity, location, observation date and maintenance-reference status; 35 hours include scanning, manual capture and correction. Missing identifiers or evidence go to manual reconciliation in s3.
The machine matches asset observations only; it does not create a serviceability or recipient-competence flag.
Native asset modules precede custom software; recipients and issue details are confirmed by the director in s3 rather than assumed available for the draft list.
research_questions: Can native matching reduce comparison time while preserving physical verification and exposing every missing identifier?

already_counted.description: Physical verification, capture, discrepancy resolution, distribution and instruction

incremental.description: Maintain asset fields and audit reconciliation failures
Support asset permissions and import integrity

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=85 gives 15 gross less 6 focal upkeep =9 central net. Report 0-2 while reconciliation prevalence is unmeasured; low case already has reliable asset matching.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Specialist preparedness and reliable equipment handling
reach: Coordinate with technical specialists on training correctness
Learn asset-evidence checks from maintenance technicians
role.ambitious_version: A director who reduces repetitive inventory comparison while keeping specialist instruction and equipment judgment accountable
